description: This source file defines an abstract base class for audio mixers used in an output transport system. It specifies required methods for starting, stopping, processing control frames, and mixing audio, intended to be subclassed for concrete implementations.

classes.name: BaseAudioMixer
classes.description: An abstract base class for output transport audio mixers that supports starting, stopping, processing control frames, and mixing audio streams.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Initializes the mixer when the output transport starts, with the provided sample rate.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the output transport stops.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: MixerControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes a control frame from the transport to adjust mixer settings or toggle its state.

methods.name: bytes mix(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Mixes incoming transport audio with generated mixer audio and returns the resulting bytes.

ctags.name: mix
ctags.pattern: /^    async def mix(self, audio: bytes) -> bytes:$/
